item.tib: dran pa drag phur bsnyen sgrub las gsum phyag bzhes dngos grub sgo 'byed 'phrul gyi lde mig
item.coloph: zhes pa'i dbal phur phyag bzhes nyung bsdus su spel ba 'di bzhin dgos zhes/ rgyal rong khro chen rgyal sras lung zin zhwa dkar 'chang ba tshe dbang nor 'dzin gyi bkas bskul ba dang / a mdo rnga ljong (ljongs) rtogs ldan mchog sprul dngos slob nges don bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dang / gter gnas sgom gral dbu 'dzin g.yung drung mthu rtsal bcas kyi (kyis) bskul bas/ raNata dmu rdzong gnas mdun 'o ze bla ma dgon gyi bla grwa thun mong dang khro chen rgyal po'i mthun sbyor bcas sgrab chen 'dzugs dus/ bya btang spral ming tshe dbang 'gyur med pas khro chen bla brang gzims (gzim) khang rtser mdzod khrid thun mtshams su lcags mo sbrul lo gsar tshes la phral du bris pas/ dge gyur cig/
